_note: Every hadith shown in the app comes from this file by id, never typed into a unit (like verses from ayahs.json). status 'draft' means the English wording has not yet been checked word for word against a verified translation and by a scholar: the app labels it as awaiting review, and npm run check warns. Set status to 'reviewed' (and fill reviewedBy) only after that check. Arabic is added only from a verified source. Only sahih hadith are used (the owner's rule, 10 Nov 2026): `grade` must begin with "Sahih" and npm run check rejects anything else. Bukhari and Muslim are sahih by their collection; for any other collection `gradedBy` names who graded it sahih and `gradeNote` records other gradings for the reviewer. Tirmidhi 2517 ("tie it and rely upon Allah") was removed: it is graded hasan, and Yahya al-Qattan called it munkar.

muslim-2999.en: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all of it is good, and that is for no one except the believer. If something good happens to him, he is thankful, and that is good for him. If something harmful befalls him, he is patient, and that is good for him.

bukhari-1283.context: The Prophet ﷺ passed a woman weeping at a grave and told her to be patient. She did not recognise him and turned him away; when she later came to apologise, he said:
bukhari-1283.en: Patience is at the first strike of a calamity.

muslim-8-islam.context: Jibril came to the Prophet ﷺ in the form of a man, sat before him and asked him about Islam, faith and excellence, while the companions watched. Asked about Islam, he said:
muslim-8-islam.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish the prayer, to give the zakat, to fast in Ramadan, and to make the pilgrimage to the House if you are able to find a way.

muslim-8-iman.context: Jibril came to the Prophet ﷺ in the form of a man, sat before him and asked him about Islam, faith and excellence, while the companions watched. Asked about faith (iman), he said:
muslim-8-iman.en: It is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers and the Last Day, and to believe in the decree, its good and its bad.

muslim-8-ihsan.context: Jibril came to the Prophet ﷺ in the form of a man, sat before him and asked him about Islam, faith and excellence, while the companions watched. Asked about excellence (ihsan), he said:
muslim-8-ihsan.en: It is to worship Allah as though you see Him, and though you do not see Him, He sees you.

bukhari-8.en: Islam is built upon five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, giving the zakat, the pilgrimage, and fasting in Ramadan.

bukhari-1.en: Actions are only by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

muslim-2564.en: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

bukhari-528.en: Tell me, if there were a river at the door of one of you and he bathed in it five times every day, would any dirt remain on him? They said: No dirt would remain on him. He said: That is the likeness of the five prayers; by them Allah wipes away sins.

bukhari-6464.en: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are few.

muslim-2588.en: Charity does not decrease wealth. Allah increases a servant in honour when he forgives, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises him.

bukhari-38.en: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and hoping for its reward, his past sins are forgiven.

bukhari-1903.en: Whoever does not give up false speech and acting upon it, Allah has no need of his giving up his food and drink.

bukhari-1521.en: Whoever performs the pilgrimage for Allah and does not speak obscenely or do wrong returns like the day his mother gave birth to him.

bukhari-2856.context: Mu'adh was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ on a donkey when he asked him:
bukhari-2856.en: Do you know what Allah's right over His servants is? It is that they worship Him and associate nothing with Him.

muslim-2996.en: The angels were created from light, the jinn were created from a smokeless flame of fire, and Adam was created from what has been described to you.

bukhari-3443.en: The prophets are brothers from one father: their mothers are different, and their religion is one.

bukhari-6018.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say what is good or keep silent. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not harm his neighbour. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his guest.

muslim-2664.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in both there is good. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not give up. If something befalls you, do not say, 'If only I had done such and such,' but say, 'Allah has decreed, and what He wills He does,' for 'if only' opens the door to the work of Satan.

tirmidhi-2516.context: The Prophet ﷺ said to Ibn Abbas, then a boy riding behind him:
tirmidhi-2516.en: Know that if the whole nation gathered together to benefit you with something, they would not benefit you except with what Allah had already written for you; and if they gathered together to harm you with something, they would not harm you except with what Allah had already written against you. The pens have been lifted and the pages have dried.
tirmidhi-2516.gradeNote: Al-Tirmidhi: hasan sahih. The Darussalam edition grades it hasan.

tirmidhi-2344.en: If you relied upon Allah as He truly should be relied upon, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds: they go out hungry in the morning and return full in the evening.
tirmidhi-2344.gradeNote: Al-Tirmidhi: hasan sahih. The Darussalam edition grades it hasan.

muslim-2963.en: Look at those who are below you and do not look at those who are above you, for that is more fitting, so that you do not belittle the blessings of Allah upon you.

abudawud-4811.en: Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

muslim-2865.en: Allah has revealed to me that you should be humble, so that no one boasts over another and no one wrongs another.

bukhari-6035.en: The best of you are those who are best in character.

muslim-2553.en: Righteousness is good character, and sin is what wavers in your heart and you would dislike people to find out about.

bukhari-6114.en: The strong one is not the one who overpowers others in wrestling; the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry.

bukhari-13.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
